purpose: Route complete content and user constraints to the Agent for a structured suitability or decision review.
applies_when: A content decision depends on user profile, constraints, or nuanced requirements.
Local keyword rules are too weak or risky.
The full content has already been read and snapshotted.
trace_requirements: Record full content text or a bounded summary with source refs.
Record user constraints/profile refs used by the Agent.
Record structured Agent verdict and reasons.
Record whether user review is required.
success_conditions: Agent receives full content, not list snippets.
Agent returns a structured pass/reject/need_user_review verdict.
Downstream entry actions are blocked unless verdict allows them.

seek_source.lesson: Real SEEK job screening must pass full job detail text to the Agent; local keyword screening must not decide suitability.
